sources.title: GoogLeNet - PyTorch
sources.snippet: Model Description GoogLeNet was based on a deep convolutional neural network architecture codenamed "Inception", which was responsible for setting the new state of the art for classification and detection in the ImageNet Large-Scale Visual Recognition Challenge 2014 (ILSVRC 2014).

sources.title: googlenet.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: The GoogLeNet model is computationally complex. Note the large number of relatively arbitrary hyperparameters in terms of the number of channels chosen, the number of blocks prior to dimensionality reduction, the relative partitioning of capacity across channels, etc.
